articles.title: Licence key box
articles.summary: Enter your Shokker Paint Booth license key (format: SHOKKER-XXXX-XXXX-XXXX, 19 characters total). It is a text box.
articles.what: Find it in Pro > Settings (gear) > License. Hint inside the box: SHOKKER-XXXX-XXXX-XXXX.

controls.label: Licence key box
controls.effect: Enter your Shokker Paint Booth license key (format: SHOKKER-XXXX-XXXX-XXXX, 19...

articles.title: Activate
articles.summary: Validate and activate your license key. It is a button.
articles.what: Find it in Pro > Settings (gear) > License.

controls.label: Activate
controls.effect: Validate and activate your license key

articles.title: Deactivate
articles.summary: required if you want to use the key on a different machine. It is a button.
articles.what: Find it in Pro > Settings (gear) > License.

controls.label: Deactivate
controls.effect: required if you want to use the key on a different machine

articles.title: ZIP export checkbox
articles.summary: Bundles paint TGA, spec TGA and preview into a ZIP on every render. It is an on/off switch.
articles.what: Find it in Pro > Settings (gear) dropdown. Bundle paint TGA, spec TGA, and preview into a ZIP on every render.
how: Click to switch it on or off.

controls.label: ZIP export checkbox
controls.effect: Bundles paint TGA, spec TGA and preview into a ZIP on every render

combos.why: Works together with the RENDER control.

articles.title: Training Wheels checkbox
articles.summary: step-by-step quests and a next-move hint chip that teach the app while you use it. It is an on/off switch.
articles.what: Find it in Pro > Settings (gear) dropdown.
how: Click to switch it on or off.

controls.label: Training Wheels checkbox
controls.effect: step-by-step quests and a next-move hint chip that teach the app while you use...

articles.title: Keyboard Shortcuts
articles.summary: Show all keyboard shortcuts (press ?). It is a button.
articles.what: Find it in Pro > Settings (gear) dropdown.

articles.title: Import TGA
articles.summary: Import an existing spec map TGA to merge under your render. It is a button.
articles.what: Find it in Pro > Settings (gear) dropdown. Browse for an existing spec map TGA to merge on top of.
when: You made a spec map elsewhere.

controls.label: Import TGA
controls.effect: Import an existing spec map TGA to merge under your render

pitfalls: Use Clear to go back to the default spec.

combos.why: Works together with the Clear (Settings (gear) dropdown) control.

articles.title: Clear (Settings (gear) dropdown)
articles.summary: Remove imported spec map and render on default base. It is a button.
articles.what: Find it in Pro > Settings (gear) dropdown.

controls.label: Clear
controls.effect: Remove imported spec map and render on default base

articles.title: Auto-deploy (Live Link) checkbox
articles.summary: Auto-deploy: copies every render to your iRacing car folder automatically. It is an on/off switch.
articles.what: Find it in Pro > Settings (gear) dropdown. Automatically copy rendered files to your iRacing car folder after each render.
how: Click to switch it on or off.

controls.label: Auto-deploy (Live Link) checkbox
controls.effect: Auto-deploy: copies every render to your iRacing car folder automatically

pitfalls: Only matters when the car folder is empty; with a car folder set, files are copied after each render anyway.

combos.why: Works together with the IRACING CAR FOLDER box control.

articles.title: Close (Esc)
articles.summary: Close shortcuts overlay (Esc). It is a button.
articles.what: Find it in Pro > Settings > Keyboard Shortcuts.
